# llms.txt — machine-friendly entry point

> Community QMK firmware for 26 Keychron Pro wireless keyboards (CKBT51):
> Bluetooth link fixes and 133 Hz report rate. Unofficial. One unit
> hardware-tested (K13 Pro ISO RGB); other images are compiled and verified only.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): hard rules and definition of done for contributors/AI.
- [docs/AI_CONTEXT.md](docs/AI_CONTEXT.md): architecture, invariants, backlog.
- [docs/SCHEMAS.md](docs/SCHEMAS.md): manifest, build status, test index, issue form contract.
- [README.md](README.md) / [README.es.md](README.es.md): user documentation (EN/ES).
- [docs/RECOVERY.md](docs/RECOVERY.md): bad-flash recovery.

## Firmware

- Source of truth: [patches/k13-audit.patch](patches/k13-audit.patch)
  (33 files under `keyboards/keychron/`, base `Keychron/qmk_firmware` @ `c8b2b23`).
- Published images: [firmware/manifest.json](firmware/manifest.json),
  [SHA256SUMS](SHA256SUMS), [firmware/](firmware/).
- Release: https://github.com/thementalcoding/keychron-pro-firmware/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- Upstream proposal: https://github.com/Keychron/qmk_firmware/pull/529
  (fork `thementalcoding/qmk_firmware`, branch `k13-pro-bt-fixes`).

## Verification

```bash
python3 tools/verify_bins.py
python3 tools/verify_manifest.py
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
python3 tools/check_sanitization.py
```
